{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch1KrEtCUApZMru3U4Jrz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The header rows of the run results table and the Compare \"Execution Results\" table now use the same label style and spacing. I checked this with unit tests, typecheck and lint only. Playwright failed to connect, so I haven't seen the result in a browser.\n\n**Cause:** the UI kit's grid styles a plain column header as 10px uppercase with wide letter spacing. In the run table, some columns used that plain header (Test Case name, Total turns, HTTP, Duration), some used a custom one, and Total requests replaced the whole header. Group labels were also mixed: Execution and Extracted used the grid's default, while metric groups used a lighter custom one. That gave four different label styles.\n\n**Fixes:**\n- **Same style everywhere:** every column label and group label in both tables now uses the same two shared header components. Both show `dial-small-semi-text text-secondary`, in normal case with no extra letter spacing. The group component used to be regular weight and is now semibold. It's only used by these run tables.\n- **Alignment:**\n  - Labels over numbers sit on the right: run number, request, total requests, turn, total turns, HTTP, duration, and numeric metrics. Total requests now keeps the grid's own header, so its right alignment works.\n  - A metric's alignment used to depend on the first row's value. If that value was empty, the label went left even though the scores below were on the right. Now any number in the column counts, and a metric with no values yet is aligned right like its \"—\" cells.\n  - Text columns (test case name, extracted values, input bindings) stay on the left.\n- **Spacing:** the Compare table's group rows were 28px while its column-label row is 40px, so the rows were uneven. They are now 40px too, matching the mockup.\n- **Letter case:** the \"INPUT BINDINGS\" group label was hard-coded in capitals. It's now \"Input bindings\".\n\n**Decision for you:** the 28px group-row height was a deliberate choice in an earlier change (`openspec/changes/archive/2026-05-13-runs-analytics-compare/design.md`), made so the extra header row in compare mode wouldn't be cut off. Going to 40px means three header rows in compare mode now take 120px instead of 96px. If that's too tall, it's a one-line revert of `COMPARE_GROUP_HEADER_HEIGHT` in `Runs/Compare/ExecutionResults/constants.ts`.\n\n**Checks:**\n- Both typechecks pass with zero errors.\n- The Runs and grid-header specs pass (947 tests). I added assertions for the shared header components and the left/right alignment.\n- ESLint reported no errors, only existing warnings.\n- I didn't run the full coverage suite.\n\nThe main changes are in `Runs/View/utils.ts` and `Runs/Compare/ExecutionResults/utils/columns.ts`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":573,"cache_read_input_tokens":93776,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":573,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c1bd5ad3-967b-4bd3-b964-563c102f715f","uuid":"1a6bd8cd-9fce-41ed-955d-7bf21bf91e85","timestamp":"2026-11-13T17:31:43.211Z"}
